scope: Prepared evaluation including output buffer encoding; excludes decode, networking, DMA and physical LEDs. Instruction counting is separate from native timing and PC sampling.

host.profile: release/bench defaults plus debug=2; atomic enabled; vm-profile disabled for timing
host.profiler: Samply 0.13.1; 12 seconds/case; main thread on-CPU samples within Criterion profiling routine; matching PDB

device.profile: opt-level=3, fat LTO, codegen-units=1, debug=2, atomic enabled
device.timing_method: 32 individual frames/case; first call included; CRC outside measured interval; p50 index16, p95 index30 of sorted32; mean truncated to integer us
device.sampling_method: Interrupted PC, no stacks; at least2 seconds/window; complete32-frame cycles; controls bracket two sampling rates

caveats: Instruction frequencies are host counts for identical bytecode and timestamps, not direct ESP32 counters.
Pair/triple counts overlap; producer-consumer checks do not prove liveness or legal branch fusion.
VM symbol self samples include inlined helpers; dispatch-line attribution is approximate and not a speedup bound.
Device ROM symbols lack size/DWARF and remain unresolved in self-symbol tables. Separate local ROM analysis suggests most starter ROM samples are double arithmetic/conversion.
Device budget exceedance is evaluation-only, not measured DMA deadlines.
First32-frame timings and uninterrupted warm controls use different cache conditions.
New archives and standalone firmware differ from previous accepted Stanford image; timings are not a regression comparison.
No new playback caches or VM/compiler optimizations were introduced.
